fusions.name: Palmed Blade
fusions.desc: Flicks a hidden blade at the first enemy in line up to 6 tiles away, dealing 18 damage and using up every affliction you have on it, with 60% more damage for each. Against something unwounded it has 50% more critical chance.

fusions.name: Flurry of Nicks
fusions.desc: Lands 3 quick nicks for 6 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Palmed and Ready
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Waits for an Opening
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
